text.en: A 2014 visit described Quality Bakery's chiffon and marble cakes as local favorites.
That visit paired tablea tsokolate with pan Legaspi served with cheese and butter.
The same account lists small and large panramona, plus lemon and chocolate cookies.
The cafe is also listed as Ruivivar's Quality Cafe in the Diaz Building on Elias Angeles Street.
